Sword of the Berserk - Guts' Rage.name: Sword of the Berserk: Guts' Rage
Sword of the Berserk - Guts' Rage.summary: An outcast warrior enters a land plagued by an evil curse. Guts is unlike ordinary men for he carries the Dragon Slayer, a mighty blade of retribution whose fury knows no equal. His enemies will know true fear once they encounter his Berserk rage!

Wolflame.name: Wolflame
Wolflame.summary: Brought to you by the makers of GIGANTIC ARMY, Supercharged Robot VULKAISER, and SATAZIUS, WOLFLAME is a return to the form of glorious 2D vertical vertical shooters like Raiden, Raptor, and Twin Cobra.
